title: The Grave Scrolls
description: Scrolls that Teleport to your last death in many ways
body:
This mod adds a magicals scroll called “Grave Scrolls”, which allows you to return to your previous death location. Yes, that’s all.

Grave Scroll:

A simple but effective scroll that teleports you back to your last death location. Perfect for recovering your items

![Grave scroll recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db2536a0b8e680a5352801a993d6b7132e1a70df.png)

Advanced Grave Scroll

 An enhanced version that not only brings you back to your death location but also grants you powerful buffs to prevent instant death upon arrival.

 ![Advanced Grave Scroll recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fc2b26a8d187cd3892a4e5b5b13adc0842662de.png)

 Master Grave Scroll

The first scroll capable of cross-dimensional teleportation. Whether you died in the Nether, End, or Overworld, this scroll will bring you back regardless of which dimension you're currently in.

![Master Grave Scroll recipe ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cb8d824f41218aef77a5a59b7d6618b5995f3a4.png)

Eternal Grave Scroll

Combines the best of everything: cross-dimensional teleportation AND enhanced protection buffs. The most powerful scroll in the mod, perfect for recovering from deaths in the most dangerous situations. 
![Eternal Grave Scroll recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6eb84f9c4aa4612ba4abb33de79b0aa1461d2b65.png)

Shadow Scroll

A unique utility scroll that grants stealth capabilities upon teleportation. After returning to your death location, you'll receive invisibility and speed, perfect for sneaking past enemies or escaping dangerous areas undetected.

![Shadow Scroll recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3347aa7f900fe1c21addffa094690d3a711c71d.png)
